subject: Genetics
title: Psychiatric Genetics
description: A quick, practical guide to Psychiatric Genetics.

hook.text: Schizophrenia is about 80% heritable—yet no single gene causes it. Over 300 risk loci found so far.

buildup.text: Bipolar disorder and depression also show strong heritability with complex, many-gene architecture.

discovery.text: Many psychiatric risk genes overlap. The same variants raise risk for schizophrenia, bipolar, and depression.

twist.text: Schizophrenia risk genes include synaptic pruning pathways. The illness may stem from brain wiring gone wrong.

climax.text: Genetics destigmatizes mental illness—showing it's biological, not a character flaw. Genes don't judge.

punchline.text: Mental illness is genetic, not moral. Genes prove it.
